theorems.name: Submission.deformation_retraction_globalize
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (c₁ : ℝ), 0 ≤ c₁ → ∃ c : ℝ≥0, ∀ (L : Set (Eucl N)) (ψ : Eucl N → Eucl N), (∀ (z : Fin N → ℤ) (x : Eucl N), x ∉ L → (∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ z i + 1) → ∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ ψ x i ∧ ψ x i ≤ z i + 1) → (∀ (z : Fin N → ℤ) (x : Eucl N), x ∉ L → (∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ z i + 1) → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∀ x' : Eucl N, x' ∉ L → (∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ x' i ∧ x' i ≤ z i + 1) → dist x' x < δ → dist (ψ x') (ψ x) ≤ (c₁ / infDist x L + ε) * dist x' x) → ∀ σ : ℝ, 0 < σ → σ ≤ 1 / 4 → LipschitzOnWith (c / Real.toNNReal σ) ψ {x | σ ≤ infDist x L}
